messages:
Sam: quick note from today's infra segment: a few product teams asked how edge-region fallbacks and autoscaler backoff interact during network flaps. starting the thread to capture answers and owners.

Priya: can you clarify: if an edge region loses connectivity briefly, do we immediately shift traffic to fallback regions or attempt local retries first?

Ken: flow is: 1) short retry window (300ms) for transient network errors, 2) if retries fail we consult region-health and fallback policy -> route to fallback, 3) autoscaler backoff triggers only if CPU/GPU pressure observed, not for pure network errors.

Maya: add nuance: we also rate-limit retries per-client to avoid thundering herd. header `x-rw-retry-count` increments. default max retries = 3.

CS_Lucy: customers noticed session interruptions when fallback happens mid-stream. what's the recommended guidance for us to tell them?

Priya: recommended guidance: 1) enable `session_affinity` on streaming routes to prefer sticky fallback per-session, 2) handle idempotent reconnection in client SDK using `session_id`, 3) instrument `x-rw-fallback` boolean to detect when a fallback occurred.

Sam: what's the backoff behavior for the autoscaler when a region is flapping between healthy/unhealthy? we don't want repeated scale-ups.

Ken: autoscaler uses exponential cool-down windows: first spike -> 2m cool-down, repeated unstable scaling extends cool-down multiplicatively up to 30m. we also bias toward stable nodes (non-preemptible) if flapping persists.

Maya: ops note: we've deployed a circuit-breaker to mark a region as 'degraded' if >5% requests hit network errors in 1m. degraded regions are deprioritized for 10m. infra-bot posted the change.

infra-bot: [deploy] region circuit-breaker v1 deployed by @Maya  changelist: 8821  link: https://redwood.internal/infra/changes/8821 :white_check_mark:

CS_Lucy: can we add a short blurb for support to explain what customers see (latency spikes, occasional 502s, or fallback) and what to recommend?

Sam: yes  I'll draft a 2-line support blurb: "If requests fail or latency spikes, our system will retry briefly then route to a fallback region if needed. Enable session_affinity to reduce mid-stream disruptions, or pin to Dedicated capacity to avoid automatic fallbacks." will post to #customer-success.

Priya: any blockers to exposing `x-rw-fallback` in the next console release?

Maya: none from infra; front-end ticket required. tagging @product for prioritization.

Ken: action items: 1) Sam to post support blurb, 2) Maya to add circuit-breaker metrics to region dashboard, 3) Priya to coordinate session_affinity docs with SDK team.

Sam: acked.

Maya: ack.

Priya: ack.
